In this video we cover:
Why EV Sales Are Slowing Down in India
India’s EV sector is hitting roadblocks — heavy reliance on subsidies, poor battery manufacturing, and weak charging infrastructure are slowing down growth. In April 2025, EV sales, especially electric two-wheelers, dropped sharply. As subsidies fade and battery plans face delays, major automakers are now shifting focus to hybrid vehicles. This video explores why India’s EV dream is stalling.
